invoice_lines_procedure_once_uq.name: invoice_lines_procedure_once_uq
invoice_lines_procedure_once_uq.where: performed_procedure_id is not null and released = false

invoices_issued_has_number.name: invoices_issued_has_number
invoices_issued_has_number.value: "invoices"."status" = 'draft' or ("invoices"."number" is not null and "invoices"."document_date" is not null)

cash_sessions_close_complete.name: cash_sessions_close_complete
cash_sessions_close_complete.value: "cash_sessions"."status" = 'open' or ("cash_sessions"."counted_minor" is not null and "cash_sessions"."expected_minor" is not null and ("cash_sessions"."counted_minor" = "cash_sessions"."expected_minor" or "cash_sessions"."discrepancy_reason" is not null))

expenses_paid_complete.name: expenses_paid_complete
expenses_paid_complete.value: "expenses"."status" <> 'paid' or ("expenses"."paid_on" is not null and "expenses"."payment_method" is not null)
